method: image_gen edit using official WeightPlay block-lion image as style reference
prompt: Create a single original square transparent PNG nine-slice border template for a children's block-world postcard puzzle. Reference the attached official block lion only for its polished geometric toy-block material and cheerful accessible forest-green and warm cream palette; do not depict any characters or animals. Orthographic flat front view, no perspective. The canvas is an exact square. Reserve the exact center from 6.25% to 93.75% of the width and height as COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT EMPTY SPACE: no speckles, shadows, glow, checkerboard or artwork in that area. Draw a very thin, simple continuous cream-and-forest-green border entirely inside the outer 6.25% band on each side. Four corners must be small matching 6.25%-square block-leaf ornaments, with all ornament pixels confined within their own corner square. Straight edge bands have a simple repeatable unmarked pattern with no central symbols so they can be stretched independently in a nine-slice UI. Outside perimeter must also be perfectly transparent. No text, numbers, logos, character, landscape, background, shadow or bevel crossing into center. Center transparency and thin edges are mandatory: puzzle landmarks beneath the frame must stay visible. Keep edges crisp, high contrast, clean and small-file-friendly. This is a functional sprite asset, not a mockup.
remaining: Verify image geometry and transparency against the brief, independent Art review, non-distorting slicing, rendered crop visibility, performance, UI and wallet integration.
